title: Rust Engine
description: A mid-register FM bass built from a sine driven into clangorous territory by a high, slowly-climbing FM index against inharmonic stepped harmonicity. Over a 32-cycle pass the squiz pitch-mangle ramps up and the ladder filter opens, dragging the metallic tone from grindy growl into screaming, degraded rust.
code:
setcpm(124/4)
stack(
  note("<f1 f1 ab1 c2 [f1 eb1] ab1 db2 c2>*2").s("sine")
    .fm(sine.slow(24).range(4, 16)).fmh("<1 2.01 1.5 3.01 0.5>/4")
    .penv("<0 0 10 -7>/8").pattack(0.002).pdecay(0.07)
    .squiz(saw.slow(32).range(1, 5))
    .lpf(sine.slow(19).range(320, 3600)).resonance(15).ftype("ladder")
    .lpenv(4).lpattack(0.004).lpdecay(0.13)
    .attack(0.003).decay(0.18).sustain(0.55).release(0.05)
    .shape(tri.slow(13).range(0.25, 0.6)).crush("<16 12 8 6>/16")
    .pan(sine.slow(7).range(0.25, 0.75))
    .off(1/8, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.3).squiz(2).pan(0.8))
    .room(0.18).gain(0.85)
)
